properties.description: Parent beacon block root MUST be provided by consensus layer before block processing begins
properties.rationale: EIP-4788 establishes CL as trusted source. Block processing cannot proceed without authenticated beacon root from consensus layer.

properties.description: Ring buffer index MUST be computed as timestamp modulo HISTORY_BUFFER_LENGTH (8191)
properties.formal_specification: FORALL timestamp: index = timestamp % 8191 AND 0 <= index < 8191
properties.rationale: Ring buffer implementation requires consistent index computation for both storage and retrieval to prevent data corruption.

properties.description: Timestamp MUST be stored at index, and beacon root MUST be stored at index + HISTORY_BUFFER_LENGTH
properties.formal_specification: AFTER store(timestamp, root): storage[index] = timestamp AND storage[index + 8191] = root
properties.rationale: Dual storage pattern ensures timestamp-to-root correspondence for stale data detection during queries.

properties.description: System call MUST be executed from SYSTEM_ADDRESS to BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS with parent beacon root as calldata
properties.rationale: System call source address ensures only block processing can invoke storage, preventing unauthorized beacon root injection.

properties.description: Query input MUST be exactly 32 bytes and non-zero before index computation
properties.formal_specification: FORALL query: QueryAccepted(query) => length(query.input) = 32 AND query.input != 0
properties.rationale: Input validation prevents malformed queries and zero-timestamp edge case from corrupting ring buffer lookups.

properties.description: Query MUST revert if stored timestamp does not match queried timestamp (stale data detection)
properties.rationale: Timestamp mismatch indicates ring buffer wraparound; returning stale beacon root could enable fraudulent proofs.

properties.description: Successful query MUST return beacon root from index + HISTORY_BUFFER_LENGTH only after timestamp match validation
properties.rationale: Ensures temporal ordering of validation before data return to prevent TOCTOU vulnerabilities.

properties.description: Execution layer MUST unconditionally trust beacon roots from consensus layer without independent verification
properties.formal_specification: FORALL root: InELHeader(root) => Trusted(root) WITHOUT ELValidation(root)
properties.rationale: EIP-4788 design decision - CL block finalization provides sufficient authentication. EL cannot independently verify beacon roots.

properties.description: Beacon block MUST be finalized on consensus layer before root is embedded in execution header
properties.rationale: Finalization provides cryptographic attestation of beacon root validity through proof-of-stake consensus.

properties.description: System call gas allocation (30M) MUST NOT be deducted from block gas limit
properties.rationale: System calls are mandatory protocol operations; deducting from block limit would reduce user transaction capacity.

properties.description: System call failure (no code at beacon roots address) MUST fail silently without reverting block processing
properties.rationale: Silent failure ensures graceful degradation on forks where beacon roots contract is not yet deployed.

properties.description: System call MUST be executed with value=0 and no EIP-1559 burn semantics
properties.rationale: System calls are fee-exempt protocol operations; applying burns would create economic distortions.

properties.description: Transaction type byte MUST be extracted from transaction envelope before routing
properties.formal_specification: FORALL tx: TxRouting(tx) => TypeExtracted(tx) BEFORE routing
properties.rationale: Type byte is the discriminator for all EIP-2718 typed transactions; processing without extraction is undefined behavior.

properties.description: Transaction types in range 0x40-0x7f (inclusive) MUST be reserved for RIP namespace
properties.rationale: EIP-7808 reserves 64 transaction types for L2 rollup specifications to prevent EIP/RIP conflicts.

properties.description: Transaction types outside 0x40-0x7f range MUST be handled by EIP standards
properties.rationale: Clear namespace separation ensures L1 mainnet controls EIP types while L2 rollups control RIP types.

properties.description: Transaction MUST follow EIP-2718 typed transaction envelope format before namespace validation
properties.rationale: EIP-2718 defines the typed envelope structure; non-compliant transactions cannot have valid type bytes.

properties.description: Unknown transaction types (not defined in EIP or RIP namespace) MUST be identified for rejection
properties.rationale: Unknown types cannot be processed safely; explicit identification enables appropriate error handling.

properties.description: L1 nodes MUST NOT process RIP transaction types as EIP types
properties.formal_specification: FORALL tx: L1_Context(tx) AND RIP_Type(tx.type) => NOT EIP_Processing(tx)
properties.rationale: RIP types have L2-specific semantics; L1 processing could cause undefined behavior or node crashes.

properties.description: Transaction routing MUST direct types based solely on numeric range, not content inspection
properties.formal_specification: Route(tx) = RIP_Path IFF 0x40 <= tx.type <= 0x7f ELSE EIP_Path
properties.rationale: Range-based routing ensures deterministic behavior without parsing transaction-type-specific content.

properties.description: Patricialize operation MUST produce valid leaf, extension, or branch nodes from key-value pairs
properties.formal_specification: Patricialize(kv_pairs) => FORALL node: node.type IN {Leaf, Extension, Branch}
properties.rationale: Valid node types ensure trie traversal and proof generation work correctly.

properties.description: Leaf nodes MUST contain rest_of_key and terminal value data
properties.formal_specification: FORALL node: node.type = Leaf => HasRestOfKey(node) AND HasValue(node)
properties.rationale: Leaf nodes are terminal; incomplete leaf nodes would make key-value retrieval fail.

properties.description: Branch nodes MUST have exactly 16 subnodes corresponding to hex nibbles 0-f
properties.rationale: Hex trie structure requires 16-way branching; incorrect branch size breaks traversal.

properties.description: Extension nodes MUST have key_segment pointing to exactly one subnode
properties.formal_specification: FORALL node: node.type = Extension => HasKeySegment(node) AND HasSingleSubnode(node)
properties.rationale: Extensions compress common prefixes; multiple subnodes would violate path compression semantics.

properties.description: trie_set with value equal to default MUST delete the key
properties.formal_specification: trie_set(key, default_value) => NOT KeyExists(key) AFTER operation
properties.rationale: Default value semantics prevent storing redundant data and maintain trie compactness.

properties.description: trie_set with value different from default MUST store the key-value pair
properties.formal_specification: trie_set(key, value) AND value != default => KeyExists(key) AND trie_get(key) = value
properties.rationale: Storage operations must be consistent; set then get must return the set value.

properties.description: trie_get for absent key MUST return default value, never error or null
properties.rationale: Consistent default semantics simplify state machine logic and prevent null pointer errors.

properties.description: copy_trie MUST create shallow copy that shares immutable frozen object references
properties.formal_specification: copy = copy_trie(original) => SharesFrozenObjects(copy, original) AND ImmutableAfterCopy(original)
properties.rationale: Frozen object semantics enable safe shallow copies without deep cloning overhead.

properties.description: Keys MUST be hashed with Keccak-256 for secured tries before nibble conversion
properties.formal_specification: secured = true => FORALL key: PreparedKey(key) = nibbles(keccak256(key))
properties.rationale: Key hashing prevents preimage attacks where attackers craft keys to manipulate trie structure.

properties.description: Unsecured tries MUST NOT hash keys, using raw key nibbles directly
properties.formal_specification: secured = false => FORALL key: PreparedKey(key) = nibbles(key)
properties.rationale: Transaction/receipt tries use sequential indices where hashing would break ordering.

properties.description: Root computation MUST return Keccak-256 hash of RLP-encoded root node when encoding >= 32 bytes
properties.rationale: 32-byte threshold ensures all Merkle proofs fit in single storage slots.

properties.description: Empty trie MUST return EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT constant without computation
properties.rationale: Constant empty root enables fast path optimization and consistent representation.

properties.description: Identical trie contents MUST produce identical root hashes across all implementations
properties.formal_specification: FORALL trie1, trie2: Contents(trie1) = Contents(trie2) => root(trie1) = root(trie2)
properties.rationale: Deterministic roots are required for consensus; hash divergence causes chain splits.

properties.description: Nibble-to-compact conversion MUST encode parity in bit 0 and node type in bit 1 of flag byte
properties.formal_specification: compact = nibble_to_compact(nibbles, is_leaf) => compact[0] & 0x01 = parity AND (compact[0] >> 1) & 0x01 = is_leaf
properties.rationale: Compact encoding flags enable decoding to distinguish leaf vs extension nodes.

properties.description: Internal node encoding MUST return hash when RLP encoding >= 32 bytes, inline otherwise
properties.formal_specification: encode_internal(node) = IF length(rlp(node)) >= 32 THEN keccak256(rlp(node)) ELSE rlp(node)
properties.rationale: 32-byte threshold balances proof size against computation; smaller nodes inline for efficiency.

properties.description: Nibble conversion MUST split each byte into two 4-bit values in big-endian order
properties.rationale: Consistent nibble ordering is critical for trie traversal path matching.

properties.description: Block timestamps MUST be monotonically increasing to prevent ring buffer collision attacks
properties.formal_specification: FORALL block_n, block_m: n < m => block_n.timestamp < block_m.timestamp
properties.rationale: Monotonic timestamps prevent attackers from overwriting recent beacon roots with stale data.

properties.description: Queries for timestamps before FORK_TIMESTAMP MUST fail due to empty storage
properties.rationale: No beacon roots stored before fork activation; queries would return garbage data.

properties.description: Beacon roots contract MUST be deployed at BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS with specified bytecode
properties.rationale: Incorrect contract code would cause storage failures or incorrect query behavior.

properties.description: RIP namespace capacity is exactly 64 transaction types (0x40 through 0x7f inclusive)
properties.rationale: Fixed namespace size enables capacity planning and prevents range overlap.

properties.description: Transaction submitter (L1 user or L2 sequencer) provides untrusted raw transaction data
properties.rationale: Transaction submitters are untrusted; all validation must occur before processing.

properties.description: Namespace authority validation MUST occur after EIP-2718 compliance validation
properties.rationale: EIP-2718 defines the envelope containing type byte; namespace check requires valid envelope.

properties.description: RIP governance MUST allocate transaction types to prevent L2 interoperability conflicts
properties.formal_specification: FORALL type_a, type_b: RIP_Allocated(type_a) AND RIP_Allocated(type_b) AND L2_a != L2_b => type_a != type_b
properties.rationale: Conflicting type allocations would cause cross-L2 transaction processing failures.

properties.description: Keccak-256 collision resistance MUST hold to prevent state forgery
properties.formal_specification: FORALL x, y: x != y => keccak256(x) != keccak256(y) (with overwhelming probability)
properties.rationale: Hash collisions would allow state forgery enabling balance manipulation or storage corruption.

properties.description: RLP encoding MUST be deterministic, producing identical bytes for identical inputs
properties.rationale: Non-deterministic encoding causes root hash divergence and consensus failures between clients.

properties.description: trie_set followed by trie_get MUST return the set value (read-after-write consistency)
properties.formal_specification: trie_get(key) AFTER trie_set(key, value) = value (when value != default)
properties.rationale: Read-after-write consistency is fundamental to state machine correctness.

properties.description: Extension nodes MUST compress shared key prefixes to minimize trie depth
properties.formal_specification: FORALL extension: length(extension.key_segment) >= 1 AND NOT IsBranchPoint(extension.key_segment)
properties.rationale: Path compression reduces trie depth, improving lookup performance and proof size.

properties.description: Leaf node compact encoding MUST set bit 1 (0x20 flag) to distinguish from extension
properties.rationale: Leaf vs extension distinction is critical for proof verification and trie traversal.

properties.description: All query validation failures MUST result in revert state, never silent failures
properties.rationale: Silent failures on invalid queries could mislead callers about data availability.

properties.description: If consensus layer is compromised, execution layer inherits that compromise for beacon roots
properties.rationale: EL cannot independently verify CL data; security is transitive from CL to EL for beacon roots.

properties.description: 32-byte encoding threshold MUST balance proof size against computation overhead
properties.rationale: Threshold chosen to fit in single storage slot while minimizing redundant hashing.

properties.description: HISTORY_BUFFER_LENGTH of 8191 provides approximately 27 hours of beacon root history at 12-second slots
properties.rationale: Buffer size balances storage costs against history availability for proof verification.

properties.description: Transaction processing context (L1 vs L2) MUST be determined before type-based routing
properties.rationale: L1 and L2 contexts have different valid type ranges; context-aware routing prevents misprocessing.
